summary: Interim Republican Sen. Darline Graham, appointed to finish her late brother Lindsey Graham's term, faces Democratic pediatrician Annie Andrews in a race that InsiderAdvantage and Trafalgar polls show essentially tied. The contest is about Graham's readiness and Andrews' record on transgender issues, with Trump and the Senate Leadership Fund stepping in for Graham as Andrews outraises her and stresses costs and the Iran war.

issues.issue: Cost of living and fuel prices
issues.why: Andrews blames the Iran war for higher fuel and grocery prices and wants the federal gas and diesel tax suspended.
Republicans attack Andrews' past advocacy on gender care and trans athletes, and she now says she opposes trans women in women's sports and gender surgery on minors.
Andrews calls Graham unserious and unqualified after a runoff debate stumble on Taiwan, and Graham says she is just as qualified.
Graham touts the Russia sanctions bill named for her brother, while Andrews says the administration undermined it by waiving key provisions.
Andrews, a children's hospital pediatrician, runs on fixing health care and lowering costs.

storylines.title: Graham says Andrews ads deceive voters
storylines.what: At a Columbia news conference Graham said Andrews misrepresents her record on youth sports and gender surgery and challenged her to release tax records, while Andrews called it culture war politics.

storylines.title: Trump rallies for Graham near Clemson
storylines.what: Trump headlined a rally in Pendleton, attacking Andrews with an anti transgender slur, while Graham urged supporters not to sit out a close race.

storylines.title: Andrews says Graham needs Washington to rescue her
storylines.what: At a town hall in Union, Andrews said national Republicans are rescuing Graham and pressed her to ask Trump to end the Iran war and restore Russia sanctions.

storylines.title: Poll shows a one point race
storylines.what: An InsiderAdvantage poll had Graham at 46 and Andrews at 45 as early voting neared, after a Trump tele rally for Graham.

storylines.title: Only debate turns personal
storylines.what: In Columbia, Andrews called Graham unqualified and raised her use of a married name, and Graham said Andrews flip flopped on everything and was deceiving voters.

storylines.title: Andrews ad answers trans attacks
storylines.what: Andrews released an ad in a doctor's coat saying she opposes trans women in women's sports and has never performed gender surgery on minors, as an allied PAC courted Republicans.

storylines.title: Senate GOP sends 5 million dollars
storylines.what: The Senate Leadership Fund committed 5 million dollars in ads for Graham as an insurance policy in a tight race.

events.title: Transgender record attacks
events.prompt: Republican ads and Trump are attacking the Democrat's past advocacy on gender care for minors and trans athletes. How does the campaign respond?

opts.label: Defend trans kids
opts.say: Stand by past advocacy and call the attacks bigotry aimed at vulnerable children.

opts.label: Clarify and pivot
opts.say: Say plainly the candidate opposes trans women in women's sports and surgery on minors, then pivot to costs.

opts.label: Press the record
opts.say: Hit the opponent's past posts calling the Save Women in Sports Act shameful and demand accountability.

events.title: Trump comes to the Upstate
events.prompt: Trump is holding a rally near Clemson for the Republican in a race polls show tied. How does the campaign play it?

opts.label: Say she needs a rescue
opts.say: Argue the opponent needs Washington politicians to speak for her and is not ready.

opts.label: Welcome and challenge
opts.say: Welcome the president but urge him to lower costs and end the Iran war.

opts.label: Rally with Trump
opts.say: Take the stage with Trump and honor his friendship with Lindsey Graham.

events.title: Fuel prices and the war
events.prompt: Voters are paying more for gas and groceries during the Iran war. What does the campaign propose?

opts.label: End the war
opts.say: Push to end the Iran war and restore Russia sanctions to bring prices down.

opts.label: Gas tax holiday
opts.say: Push to suspend the federal gas and diesel tax for families and truckers.

opts.label: Trust the president
opts.say: Say inflation is under control and the president will end the conflicts.

events.title: Questions about readiness
events.prompt: A runoff debate stumble on Taiwan and an attack on the use of a married name have put the appointed senator's readiness on the ballot. How does the campaign handle it?

opts.label: Call her unqualified
opts.say: Keep hammering that the senator is unserious and unready for a full six year term.

opts.label: Contrast resumes
opts.say: Compare experience and plans calmly and let voters judge.

opts.label: Lean on the legacy
opts.say: Tout the Russia sanctions bill and the Graham family name as proof of results.

endorsements.who: Senate Majority Leader John Thune campaigned for Graham
Former Aiken County Council member Scott Singer, a Republican

ads.theme: Andrews in a doctor's coat says she opposes trans women in women's sports and gender surgery on minors and says Graham is lying.
A 5 million dollar buy reminding voters that Andrews is a Democrat.
Testimonials from lifelong Republicans aimed at giving GOP voters permission to back Andrews.
